raw: {"title":"圆轨道、匀速圆周与竖直绳圈物理模型","domain":"circular","model_js":"globalThis.coursewareModel=Object.freeze({sample(input){const s=(input&&input.scenario)||{};const angles=Array.isArray(input&&input.angles_rad)?input.angles_rad:[];const m=Number(s.mass_kg),r=Number(s.radius_m),g=Number(s.g_m_s2),G=Number(s.G_n_m2_kg2),M=Number(s.central_mass_kg),mode=s.mode||'uniform';let v0=Number(s.speed_m_s);if(mode==='orbit'){v0=Math.sqrt(G*M/r);}function kinematics(v){const a=v*v/r;return{ac:a,Fr:m*a};}let period_s=0;let centripetal_acceleration_m_s2=0;const events={period_s:0,centripetal_acceleration_m_s2:0};if(mode==='vertical_string'){const kin=kinematics(v0);centripetal_acceleration_m_s2=kin.ac;events.critical_top_speed_m_s=Math.sqrt(g*r);events.critical_bottom_speed_m_s=Math.sqrt(5*g*r);const v2at=function(th){return v0*v0-2*g*r*(1-Math.cos(th));};if(v0>0&&v2at(Math.PI)>0){const N=8192,h=2*Math.PI/N;let sum=0;for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){const th=i*h;const v2=Math.max(v2at(th),1e-15);const f=r/Math.sqrt(v2);sum+=(i===0||i===N)?f:(i%2?4*f:2*f);}period_s=sum*h/3;}}else{const kin=kinematics(v0);centripetal_acceleration_m_s2=kin.ac;period_s=v0>0?2*Math.PI*r/v0:0;}events.period_s=period_s;const states=angles.map(function(th){let x,y,v,ax,ay,Fr,T,K,U;if(mode==='vertical_string'){const sn=Math.sin(th),cs=Math.cos(th);x=r*sn;y=-r*cs;const v2=Math.max(0,v0*v0-2*g*r*(1-cs));v=Math.sqrt(v2);ax=-g*sn*cs-(v2/r)*sn;ay=-g*sn*sn+(v2/r)*cs;Fr=m*v2/r;T=Fr+m*g*cs;K=0.5*m*v2;U=m*g*r*(1-cs);}else{const cs=Math.cos(th),sn=Math.sin(th);x=r*cs;y=r*sn;v=v0;const a=v*v/r;ax=-a*cs;ay=-a*sn;Fr=m*a;T=mode==='uniform'?Fr:0;K=0.5*m*v*v;U=mode==='orbit'?-G*M*m/r:0;}return{angle_rad:th,x_m:x,y_m:y,speed_m_s:v,ax_m_s2:ax,ay_m_s2:ay,radial_force_n:Fr,tension_n:T,kinetic_j:K,potential_j:U,mechanical_j:K+U};});return{states:states,events:events};}});"}
